purpose: Define the deterministic state, viewport, capture, provenance and failure contract that P0 must implement for exact-build HTML5 visual evidence.

runtime_contract.capture_ready_rule: The engine sets captureReady=true only after the requested state is fully applied, async resources needed by the state are ready, transient setup effects are finished, and the simulation is frozen or at the state's declared deterministic capture frame.

determinism.state_source: repository-authored QA fixtures, never player save data
determinism.wall_clock: not an input to captured state
determinism.network: no network dependency for required capture states
determinism.storage: fresh isolated browser context per state unless a storage lifecycle test explicitly requires persistence
determinism.simulation: state declares a stable frame or frozen checkpoint before capture
determinism.browser_context: new isolated Playwright BrowserContext per independent state capture

viewports.role: representative wide landscape device/container crop and touch-layout QA

assertions: exact viewport capture is byte-stable across isolated repeated contexts
decoration does not read as interactable
control not hidden by reward feedback
locked state uses more than hue
player can identify next useful action
owned seed and plant action readable
campaign identity remains distinct from planted expression
world transformation materially stronger than dormant

capture_pipeline.serve_requirement: HTTP server with correct application/wasm MIME type; file:// is forbidden
capture_pipeline.browser_version_policy: pin in P0 CI lockfile/tool setup and record exact version in report
capture_pipeline.capture_surface: full browser viewport including canvas/container layout
steps: build one HTML5 bundle from that head
create isolated browser context for capture
navigate to requested qa route with fixed seed
wait for JavaScript bridge engineReady and captureReady
assert bridge stateId, seed and buildCommitSha
collect page errors and unexpected console errors
capture PNG and required motion evidence
capture_pipeline.css_animation_policy: browser chrome/page CSS may be disabled for capture; game-canvas motion must be controlled by the engine QA state rather than hidden by Playwright

fail_capture_when: bridge not available in development/CI build
required screenshot or motion artifact missing
capture dimensions differ from configured viewport
release bundle exposes QA bridge or responds to QA state injection
failure_policy.player_facing_pr_gate_after_p0: A player-facing PR must declare affected QA states. CI fails when any declared required state/viewport evidence is missing from the exact-head artifact package.
failure_policy.image_regression_policy: Do not introduce a universal pixel-diff threshold in P-1. P0 establishes stable renderer/browser evidence first; deterministic surfaces may then adopt thresholded golden comparisons while semantic/art changes remain separately evaluated.

p0_bb006: one known state captured on desktop and mobile
later: runtime artifact hash enforcement in evidence policy
